description: Find published articles by topic keywords, publisher or publication name. Case and spacing/punctuation in names are normalized. Meaningful query words must match metadata together or an individual passage; this is lexical retrieval, not semantic answer generation. Use publication/publisher filters (name or ID) to exclude other publications. For a question, choose one or two specific topic keywords. Returns public metadata and publisher teasers only, including matches inside paid articles. Follow next with the SAME query and filters to search older archive sections.
name: search_articles
